title: Audit CI package retention and retrieval binding

findings.failure: Linux upload name, path, retention-days, receipt path, and if-no-files-found are not pinned by the workflow validator that does pin the macOS equivalents.
findings.invariant: Retained Linux package and receipt must remain the event-head named artifact with 7-day retention.
findings.correction: If P005/P094 own CI YAML, extend hasMacNativeProof-style checks to ci.yml job test step 7; do not duplicate checksum tests.

findings.failure: if-no-files-found:error applies to the combined path set. A package directory without receipt.json still uploads.
findings.invariant: Proof identity requires receipt.json; package identity does not.
findings.correction: Treat missing receipt as a retrieval-binding failure for proof, not as absent package. Checker already distinguishes MISSING vs FAILED_PROOF vs PASS.

findings.location: upload-artifact@ea165f8d README (fetched 2026-09-06) plus mixed workspace glob and runner.temp paths
findings.failure: Extracted paths are not uniquely determined by YAML. Wildcard flattening and least-common-ancestor interact.
findings.invariant: Bind BUILD.json and receipt.json by basename.
findings.correction: Do not hard-code dist/kizuki-0.1.0/... as the only download layout.

findings.failure: Pinned action outputs artifact-id, artifact-url, artifact-digest are unused.
findings.invariant: Zip digest is not retrievable from current workflow outputs.
findings.correction: Optional: capture outputs behind a step id. Not required to bind package identity; BUILD.json and SHA256SUMS already hash the files.

findings.failure: Name grammars differ. Equal on workflow_dispatch because ci-diff-check.ts requires HEAD == GITHUB_SHA. inputs.base_sha is not in the artifact name.
findings.invariant: Artifact name SHA must equal BUILD.json.source_sha.
Hashes, not execute bits, are the retained proof.

limitations: No Git metadata in /repo; HEAD identity is FLEET-SOURCE-IDENTITY.json only.
Remote issue/PR/CI association for issue 540 was not refreshed.
No live Actions artifact was downloaded; path layout uses documented glob/LCA rules plus a synthetic LCA fixture.
Native package was not built (build-release.ts requires git rev-parse HEAD).
upload-artifact permission loss and digest behavior cited from fetched docs, not from a run on this SHA.
Draft checker is /work/out only; it is not integrated into scripts/verify-workflows.ts.

use: workflow-artifact-graph.json as the current upload/retention map
check-download-listing.ts as the retrieval adapter in front of go-no-go.ts local evidence indexes
coverage-audit.md so Linux upload pinning is added rather than checksum tests duplicated
retrievable_proof: SHA256SUMS over kizuki, kizuki-mcp, README.txt, BUILD.json
receipt.json source_sha, package_sha256, binary_sha256, failures, engine_observations when present
artifact name SHA for linux-x64-<sha> and macos-arm64-<sha>

next_step: P005/P094 should consume the graph and checker, pin Linux ci.yml upload fields if they own that YAML, and keep go-no-go.ts as the local package+receipt verifier rather than inventing a second checksum contract.
